title: Sagrada Família Tour
text: Tour guide was very informative and engaging! Would highly recommend as it provides more context to the building.
author: 413pranavm

title: Excellent tour w/ Jose!
text: Jose was a fantastic guide who made our visit to the Sagrada Familia both informative and enjoyable. His explanations of Gaudí’s vision, the architectural details, and the religious symbolism gave us a much greater appreciation for the basilica than we would have had visiting on our own. The 90-minute tour was well worth it. Highly recommend this experience, especially with Jose as your guide!
author: jonathanhunterf

title: Historic tour
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable and provided a great history of the structure. It was easy to find the meeting place and the size of the group was manageable. Our guide was great with any questions we had. Overall, very good experience as we would not have learned much trying to go on our own.

title: A Vivid Journey Through Gaudí’s Life and the Sagrada Família
text: This was a very energetic, clear, and deeply engaging tour with our wonderful tour guide-Marta Roca! Marta let us experience Gaudí’s work through vivid historical storytelling that connects his personal life with both the exterior facades and interior engineering. We were also impressed by her organized, attentive leadership from start to finish!!!
